brand.name: Pine Opti
brand.aesthetic: Hacker/cyber/pro-gamer, native Windows .exe feel, high-end PC optimization dashboard

headings.usage: H1, H2, primary navigation, major CTAs

body.usage: Data points, logs, AI chat, system settings, general text

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Dashboard density. Control room bento grid for data, asymmetric layout for main sections.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Narrow icon-rail (w-16) expanding on hover/active to show labels (w-64).
layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: p-4 for small cards, p-6 for main panels, p-8 for hero sections

buttons.primary: bg-[#14ff72] text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm hover:bg-[#00e660] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(20,255,114,0.4)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#14ff72]/50 text-[#14ff72] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm hover:bg-[#14ff72]/10 transition-all
buttons.pro: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#d926ff] to-[#9d00ff] text-white font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(217,38,255,0.4)] transition-all

inputs.style: bg-[#05070A] border border-white/10 text-white rounded-sm focus:border-[#14ff72] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#14ff72]/50

motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered slide-up fade (framer-motion or CSS keyframes), delay 50ms per item.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle scale (scale-105 for icons), neon glow on borders.
motion_and_interactions.scan_animation: Matrix/terminal style text scrolling, progress bar with glowing leading edge.

images.description: Dark abstract background with subtle neon green glowing grid and noise texture. Use as main app background behind glassmorphism.
Magenta glowing abstract particle background for the PRO activation card.

icons_library: lucide-react (primary) or @phosphor-icons/react (for gaming feel). Phosphor is recommended: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all neon text over dark backgrounds passes 4.5:1.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-optimization-btn')

views_and_features.dashboard_inicio: User count, Optimization %, PRO card, CPU/GPU circular gauges, Big CTA card with logo, right side News/AI tips panel.
views_and_features.optimización: Left subnav (Mis ajustes, Básico, Seguridad, etc.). Long list of settings with 'Editado'/'Predeterminado' badge. Sticky 'Aplicar' button. Anti-cheat protection panel under Seguridad (BlackBox, Keller SS, EAC, Vanguard) - shown locked.
views_and_features.herramientas: Grid of glassmorphic cards for tools (StoreX, GameModeX, etc.) with varied gradients.
views_and_features.tweax_ai: Full-page chat, mode tabs, input bar, cyberpunk bot persona.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML divs and sections styled with Tailwind for the main layouts. Use Shadcn only for complex interactive bits like Tabs or Select.
Implement the background images with fixed positioning, low opacity, and cover size.
Ensure all text is in Spanish as requested.
Mock the scan functionality with a fake progress flow and a mocked Claude JSON response simulating PC optimization.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, tabs, and critical containers.
Wrap the layout in a fixed 100vh container to simulate a desktop .exe application without browser scrolling on the body. Only scroll inner panes.
